description: Raw LLM input/output logs for the SYNCRISK main run. The full raw_io_*.jsonl files (87,845 records) are NOT shipped because the request `messages` embed licensed EODHD news headlines. This manifest gives per-file record counts and a single response-only sample (prompt withheld). The parsed model outputs themselves ship in full in scores_P0.parquet / scores_P3.parquet.

sample_record_response_only.response:
```json
{
  "relative_risk_score": 28,
  "tail_risk_rank": 2,
  "de_risking_signal": "hold",
  "confidence": 0.82,
  "brief_reason": "Low volatility, modest drawdown, positive momentum, elevated beta offset by benign risk metrics and constructive sentiment."
}
```
